name: contextdeck-monorepo
description: Local-first, Git-backed shared context board for humans and multiple AI coding agent harnesses.

scripts.build:backend: pnpm --filter @contextdeck/core build && pnpm --filter @contextdeck/server build && pnpm --filter @contextdeck/cli build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @contextdeck/core build && pnpm --filter @contextdeck/server build && pnpm -r typecheck
